ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure is the “Longjing Ecological Chain Planting and Breeding Cycle Diagram”; at the top there is “food processing,” in the middle there are breeding such as rare birds and “yellow mealworms,” and in the lower center there is a “biogas digester.” In the figure, waste produced by food processing, crop straw, breeding manure and other wastes flow to the “biogas digester,” and the biogas digester then outputs “biogas,” used for lighting lamps, cooking, heat preservation, etc. Then reason: Since the arrows of these wastes enter the biogas digester, and the main output of the biogas digester is biogas, they are used to produce biogas.
